interpretation: The end-to-end official evidence pipeline is technically compatible with real CNInfo PDFs in the bounded sample.
The four NOT_ESTABLISHED outputs are document-level diagnostic outcomes only; they are not definitive company-level non-AI claims.
Three selected filings were administrative notices about attending an AI-industry group performance briefing and did not contain the frozen positive AI-Core conjunction.
Candidate search title/keyword matches are therefore materially noisier than classifier-ready business evidence.

problem_elimination_decision.problem: Repeatedly materializing obvious low-information administrative meeting notices wastes network, extraction and classification work.
problem_elimination_decision.delete: Suppress a narrowly defined class of administrative performance-briefing attendance/meeting notices before PDF materialization.
problem_elimination_decision.safety: Suppression has NO negative eligibility meaning and produces NO_STATE_CHANGE only.
do_not_suppress: other documents not matched by the narrow administrative-notice rule
